snippet.title: BBQ DAD: First Bite release trailer (or, I released my first video game!)
snippet.description:
Start your quest to become a BBQ DAD. Choose your DAD, select your menu, and get grillin'! Grab it here: https://robthez.itch.io/bbq-dad

I tried to make this in a week. Three weeks later, here it is! I didn't make it on my own though, here are some of the amazing people who helped:

DAD designs by @Catbutter
Music by Matt Javanshir (https://mattjavanshir.com)
Food sprites - Geraldine "Greywyrd" Harris (https://deviantart.com/geruru)
Design by Lucy Hattersley
BBQ DAD logo by invaderroxas (https://www.fiverr.com/invaderroxas)

And many more!

Enjoy!
